page_title: Skilly: Voice AI Tutor for Mac That Points at the Button

summary.name: Skilly
summary.one_liner: Skilly is a voice AI tutor for Mac that answers spoken questions about the app on your screen and points at the control you need.
use_cases: Learning a new design app like Figma or Canva
Finding export settings or keyboard shortcuts
Asking where a setting lives in a builder like Webflow or Bubble
Getting help in VS Code, Docker Desktop, or a Git client
Getting step-by-step help in Sheets, Slides, or Notes without searching tutorials
summary.what_it_does: Skilly for Mac listens to a spoken question, replies in voice with steps, and points at the relevant control on screen. It answers based on what is currently on the screen rather than generic advice. The page says it works across many apps, including design tools, web builders, developer tools and everyday office apps. App-specific skills can add lessons, vocabulary and documentation, and users can create private skills for tools they want to learn. A Chrome, Edge and Firefox extension provides similar voice guidance and pointing on a chosen webpage.
notable: Voice question and answer combined with on-screen pointer that highlights the exact button
Bring-your-own OpenAI key option at $5/month plus OpenAI usage, or $19/month hosted
Browser extensions for Chrome, Edge and Firefox
Claims the code is open for inspection and that audio, screens and prompts are not stored in analytics
caveats: Runs on Mac today; Windows, Linux and phone versions are waitlist-only
Free 15-minute hosted trial, then paid plans ($19/month hosted or $5/month plus own OpenAI usage)
Hosted usage pauses until the next cycle once the included hours are used
